label: Figure 7.5: Consumer surplus in the market for vinyl records
alt: Demand and supply for vinyl records with the triangle above the $12 price and below the demand curve shaded as consumer surplus, labelled a, b and c.
caption: Consumer surplus is the shaded triangle abc: the area below the demand curve and above the $12 equilibrium price, out to the equilibrium quantity of 1,200 records. It shows how much more consumers were willing to pay than they actually had to.
